products.title: KiananStudio 3D Collider
products.shortDescription: Generate colliders automatically or create and edit optimized collider shapes directly in the Unity Scene view.
products.description: KiananStudio 3D Collider is a Unity Editor tool for automatic Mesh Collider generation and manual collider editing. Automatic generation can preserve openings, holes, tunnels and concave spaces, while the Collider Editor lets you build and adjust collider geometry directly in the Scene view. For Rigidbody workflows, multiple convex MeshColliders can be combined into an efficient compound collider.
features: Collider Editor with Vertex, Edge, Face and Collider editing modes
Shift multi-selection for vertices, edges and faces
Face Extrude for extending collider geometry
Add Collider for independent collider sections
Delete Collider for removing selected sections
Compound convex MeshCollider workflow for Rigidbody objects
Preserves important openings, holes, tunnels and concave spaces
Created Colliders counter for easier optimization and comparison
Persistent generated meshes with cleanup and Undo/Redo support

blocks.heading: About
blocks.content: KiananStudio 3D Collider is a Unity Editor tool for generating and manually editing Mesh Colliders for complex 3D models. Automatic generation detects visible surfaces and can preserve openings, holes, tunnels and concave spaces. The Collider Editor adds direct Scene view editing for custom collider shapes.

blocks.heading: What's new in 1.1.0
blocks.content:
Collider Editor with Vertex, Edge, Face and Collider modes

Shift multi-selection for vertices, edges and faces

Face Extrude for extending collider geometry

Add Collider for independent collider sections

Delete Collider for removing selected sections

Compound convex collider workflow for Rigidbody objects

Created Colliders counter in the Inspector

Improved generated mesh persistence, cleanup and Undo/Redo

Automatic migration from Assets/3dCollider to Assets/KiananStudio/3D Collider

blocks.heading: Features
blocks.content:
Automatic surface-based Mesh Collider generation

Non-convex colliders for static, concave and open models

Closed convex colliders for Rigidbody objects and triggers

Manual Collider Editor directly in the Unity Scene view

Vertex, Edge, Face and Collider editing modes

Shift multi-selection and Face Extrude

Independent Add Collider and Delete Collider workflow

Compound convex MeshColliders for complex Rigidbody shapes

Preserves important openings, holes, tunnels and concave spaces

Persistent generated meshes with cleanup and Undo/Redo support

Built-in, URP and HDRP compatible

No external package dependencies

sitePages.title: Bronchoscopy
sitePages.heading: Bronchoscopy
sitePages.content:
Bronchoscopy is an interactive simulator designed for practicing bronchoscope navigation and basic endoscopic skills in a virtual environment.
Explore the airways, learn to control the bronchoscope, and become familiar with navigation through the bronchial tree using simple and intuitive controls.
The simulator is designed as a practical training and demonstration tool. Future versions may expand the experience with additional procedures, training scenarios, and new interactive features.
Bronchoscopy is intended for educational and simulation purposes only and is not a medical device.

blocks.heading: Installation on Android
blocks.content:
To install the APK, Android may ask you to allow installation from unknown sources.
Download the APK file.
Open the downloaded file.
If Android blocks the installation, open Settings when prompted.
Enable Allow from this source for the browser or file manager you used to open the APK.
Return to the installer and continue the installation.
After installation, you can disable this permission again if you prefer.
The wording and location of this setting may vary depending on the Android version and device manufacturer.
